component_name: Alert to guardian on serious harm, bounded
text: Where the service detects a risk of serious harm to a child, the provider shall notify the child's verified parent or guardian without delay, stating the nature of the concern and the steps available to respond.

component_name: Alert to guardian on serious harm, bounded
text: Notification to a parent or guardian shall be limited to acute risks above a threshold set by the provider and documented in its risk assessment, and shall not be sent for routine or low-risk activity.

component_name: Alert to guardian on serious harm, bounded
text: The child shall be informed, in age-appropriate terms, that notifications may be sent to a parent or guardian, and shall be told when one has been sent.

component_name: Alert to guardian on serious harm, bounded
text: A child shall be able to reach a helpline or counselling service through the service without parental notification or consent.
Parental controls and supervision settings shall be linked to an account whose holder has been verified as the child's parent or guardian by at least two independent authentication factors.
A child's account shall not be capable of removing or altering supervision settings set by a verified guardian.
The provider shall take reasonable steps to detect and prevent a child from accessing the service through an account registered to an adult, and shall not rely on self-declaration of age.
Verification data collected for these purposes shall be used only for that purpose and deleted once no longer needed.
